_comment: Copy this to tests/_truth.json and fill in values from YOUR extraction. _truth.json is gitignored. When absent, tests assert structural correctness only; with it, they also check known values.
known_rrn_any: <one RRN string known to appear in the messages domain>

known_merchant.vpa: <a merchant VPA appearing in passbook, e.g. example-1234@ptybl>
known_merchant.global_search_token: <a substring of the merchant's name visible in app-state>

crash_user_id: <paytm user id surfaced in crash sessions>
